Geographic fit

Temporal fit 
Static 1987 coefficients and group-catch mixture proxies are applied across 1950–
2019. The 2019 reference is 32 years later; publication 2009 does not update 
ecosystem conditions. Annual ecosystem change is not reconstructed.
